covalent_radius.label: Atomic size
covalent_radius.explain: Half the distance between two bonded atoms of the element. Bigger means a larger atom.

ionization_energy.label: Ionization energy
ionization_energy.explain: Energy needed to remove one electron from a neutral gas-phase atom.

electronegativity.label: Electronegativity (Pauling)
electronegativity.explain: How strongly an atom pulls on shared electrons in a bond.

electronegativity_allen.label: Configuration energy (Allen)
electronegativity_allen.explain: Average energy of the valence electrons in the free atom. Allen's electronegativity scale is based on it; it is not on the Pauling scale.

vdw_radius.label: van der Waals radius
vdw_radius.explain: Half the closest distance between two atoms that are touching but not bonded.

melting_point.label: Melting point
melting_point.explain: Temperature at which the solid melts at 1 atm.

boiling_point.label: Boiling point
boiling_point.explain: Temperature at which the liquid boils at 1 atm.

density.label: Density
density.explain: Mass per volume of the element at room temperature (gases at 0 °C, 1 atm).

atomic_weight.label: Atomic mass
atomic_weight.explain: Average mass of the element's atoms, relative to 1/12 of carbon-12.
